name: Sitadel Building Permits
description: Official French open data for building permits and other planning authorizations recorded in Sitadel. Covers housing, non-residential premises, development permits, and demolition permits since 2013, updated monthly. Public records retain the work location and permit number but remove protected personal applicant details.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Get Sitadel dataset metadata, current data-file identifiers, field schemas, millesimes, row counts, and update dates.

tools.name: list_housing_authorizations
tools.description: Page through permits and prior declarations that create housing. Returns project state and milestone dates, work address/cadastral location, unit counts, surfaces, and non-protected applicant fields when available.

millesime.description: Optional historical release in YYYY-MM format; omit for latest.

orderBy.description: Comma-separated fields; prefix descending fields with -, for example `-DATE_REELLE_AUTORISATION`.

tools.name: list_non_residential_authorizations
tools.description: Page through authorizations that create or extend non-residential premises, including commercial and industrial projects.

tools.name: list_development_permits
tools.description: Page through French permis d'aménager records for land development projects.

tools.name: get_datafile_metadata
tools.description: Get metadata and the current field schema for any Sitadel data file returned by get_dataset.
